description: Goal Progress Visualization - Enhanced progress bars for savings goals showing percentage complete, amount remaining, days remaining, and milestone celebrations.
steps: Enhance existing lib/screens/savings_goals_screen.dart to improve goal cards: replace simple progress bar with enhanced visualization showing: (1) large circular progress indicator with percentage in center, (2) current amount / target amount below, (3) color-coded progress (red <25%, orange 25-50%, yellow 50-75%, green 75-100%), (4) 'X days remaining' until deadline if set
Add milestone markers to progress visualization: show icons at 25%, 50%, 75%, 100% checkpoints. Animate checkmark appearing when milestone is passed.

Add goal insights card below each goal showing: (1) 'You need to save ₱X per day to reach goal by deadline', (2) 'At current rate, you'll reach goal on [projected date]', (3) 'You're X% ahead/behind pace' based on time elapsed vs progress made

Add celebration animation when goal is completed (100%): show full-screen Peso mascot celebration with confetti animation (use existing peso_mascot.dart widget), play sound effect if enabled, save achievement to achievements database
Add goal history tracking: create goal_history table (id, goal_id, amount_added, date, note) to track all contributions. Show contribution history timeline in goal detail view.

Enhance goal detail view (tap on goal card) to show: circular progress, insights, contribution history timeline (reverse chronological list of deposits), projection chart (if deadline set), and action buttons (Add Funds, Edit Goal, Complete Early, Delete)
Add 'Add Funds to Goal' quick action from multiple screens: home screen goal widget, goal list, goal detail, with amount input and optional note. Updates current_amount and creates history entry.
acceptance_criteria: Goal cards show circular progress with percentage and color-coding
Milestone markers (25%, 50%, 75%) appear on progress indicator
Goal insights calculate daily savings needed and projected completion date
Completing a goal (100%) triggers Peso celebration animation and sound
Goal detail view shows contribution history timeline
Add Funds quick action updates goal progress and creates history entry
verification: Test scenario 1: Goal with ₱30k of ₱50k target → circular progress shows 60% with yellow color
Test scenario 2: Goal with 20 days remaining and ₱15k needed → insight shows 'Save ₱750 per day to reach goal'
Test scenario 3: Add ₱5k to goal → goal updates to ₱35k, contribution appears in history timeline
Test scenario 4: Add final ₱15k to reach 100% → Peso celebration animation plays with confetti and sound
Test scenario 5: Goal detail view shows 5 contributions in timeline with dates, amounts, and notes
